title: Ski HUD and Winter Fun window (skis, snowboard, sledge, snow disc)
layout_order: HUD band across the bottom above the toolbar, one row: LEFT speedometer (dial, speed figure, MPH/KM/H units chip, TOP) then STEEPNESS box over BIGGEST AIR / IN THE AIR box | CENTRE mode words (and the no-talk note), run clock with RUN TIME / LAST RUN, VERTICAL box and HEADING box with compass, keys line along the bottom | RIGHT STYLE box (score, combo chip, points line), BEST HERE, TAKE THEM OFF / TAKE IT OFF / GET OFF (top right), HELP, PANEL, HIDE under it, the ride's name bottom right | pop-ups and the help card above the band's middle | resize grip on the top edge. Winter Fun window: intro, 1. Choose (Skis, Snowboard / Sledge, Snow disc), How to ride text, 2. Go (Put ... on), Get off, Show the Ski HUD, status line, two tick boxes

controls.label: MPH / KM/H chip under the speed figure
controls.tip: Speeds in miles an hour. Click for kilometres an hour. / Speeds in kilometres an hour. Click for miles an hour.
source: "Speeds in miles an hour. Click for kilometres an hour."
"Speeds in kilometres an hour. Click for miles an hour."

controls.label: TAKE THEM OFF (skis) / TAKE IT OFF (snowboard) / GET OFF (sledge, snow disc)
controls.tip: Stand up and take them off. They go back to your inventory, ready for next time. / Stand up and get off. It goes back to your inventory, ready for next time.
source: WolfSkis::isSled(sk.kind()) ? "GET OFF" : sk.kind() == WolfSkis::KIND_SNOWBOARD ? "TAKE IT OFF" : "TAKE THEM OFF"
"Stand up and get off. It goes back to your inventory, ready for next time."
"Stand up and take them off. They go back to your inventory, ready for next time."

controls.label: HELP
controls.tip: How to ride: every key, and how the points work
controls.action: help card on/off (mShowHelp), stops the first-time auto help
source: "HELP", H_HELP, "How to ride: every key, and how the points work"
case H_HELP: mShowHelp = !mShowHelp; mHelpAuto = false; break;

controls.label: PANEL (lit when the background is on)
controls.tip: Background on: click to float the read-outs over the world / Background off: click to put the panel back
controls.action: flip setting WolfSkiHudBackground (off: each read-out keeps its own dark backing and clicks between them reach the world)
source: "Background on: click to float the read-outs over the world"
"Background off: click to put the panel back"

controls.label: HIDE
controls.tip: Hide this HUD while you ride (Wolf World > Winter Fun... brings it back)
source: "Hide this HUD while you ride (Wolf World > Winter Fun... brings it back)"

controls.name: speedometer
controls.label: dial 0-90 mph / 0-140 km/h, ice/gold/red band, ticks and figures, gold tick at the run's top speed, needle eased to the speed, speed figure
source: // top speed this run: a gold tick on the dial
T(cx, cy - S(40.f), llformat("%.0f", v), 34.f, SNOW, true, true);

controls.name: top-speed
controls.label: TOP <n> MPH|KM/H / TOP --

controls.name: steepness
controls.label: STEEPNESS: the slope drawn at its angle with a rider dot, degrees (or --), piste chip GENTLE / BLUE / RED / BLACK

controls.name: air-time
controls.label: BIGGEST AIR / IN THE AIR (gold while flying), <n.n> s or --, best here <n.n> s / E to jump / bumps throw you up

controls.name: mode-words
controls.label: the ride's state over the clock: wipe out, in the air, water, ready, run over / push off, and for sledges heels in / pushing / leaning left|right xN / sliding, for skis and boards tucked / heel brake / snowplough / pushing / skating / carving xN / running
source: "READY - PRESS AN ARROW KEY TO GO"
"RUN OVER - PUSH OFF FOR ANOTHER" : "PUSH OFF TO START (UP ARROW, OR POINT DOWNHILL)"
llformat("LEANING LEFT  x%d", s.mCombo) : std::string("LEANING LEFT")
llformat("LEANING RIGHT  x%d", s.mCombo) : std::string("LEANING RIGHT")

controls.name: no-talk-note
controls.label: (this ride does not talk to the HUD: jumps and tricks are not scored)
controls.when: the ride's script has not answered the hello
source: "(this ride does not talk to the HUD: jumps and tricks are not scored)"

controls.name: run-clock
controls.label: m:ss.t with RUN TIME / LAST RUN

controls.name: vertical
controls.label: VERTICAL <n> m

controls.name: heading
controls.label: HEADING: N NE E SE S SW W NW and a compass needle (up = north); a snow disc shows the way it is going

controls.name: keys-line
controls.label: the keys along the bottom for the ride sat on (keys are the ride script's, not the viewer's)
source: "Steer: Left / Right arrows   -   Slow down: Down arrow   -   Push along: Up arrow"
"Turn: Left / Right   -   Slow down: Down   -   Push: Up   -   Jump: E   -   Crouch (faster): C"

controls.name: style
controls.label: STYLE score, combo chip xN (pulsing, while running), points this run / points this run - N turns round / last run / last run - a new best! / jump, spin, carve / bumps, turns, speed
source: llformat("points this run  -  %d turns round", s.mSpins)

controls.name: best-here
controls.label: BEST HERE: <pts> pts <top> <unit> <air> s air / no runs here yet (this computer, this region: setting WolfSkiBests)
source: llformat("%s pts   %.0f %s   %.1f s air", thousands(s.mBestScore).c_str(), s.mBestTop * k, unit, s.mBestAir)

controls.name: ride-name
controls.label: WOLF SKIS / WOLF SNOWBOARD / WOLF SLEDGE / WOLF SNOW DISC (bottom right)
source: if (bg) T(X(1588.f), YM(860.f), hudName(sk.kind()), 10.f, ICE_DIM, true, false, LLFontGL::RIGHT);

controls.name: popups
controls.label: call-outs above the band, rising and fading over 3 s: Run over, New personal best!, combo cheers, Splash!, Bump!, Big air!, Nice jump!, spins, Wipe out!, Round and round!
source: popup("New personal best!", "Kept for this region on this computer", 1);

controls.name: help-card
controls.label: HOW TO RIDE card: ski/board lines or sledge/disc lines (HOW TO RIDE - THE ARROW KEYS ONLY), STYLE POINTS, Click HELP again to close this. Shows by itself the first time (WolfSkiHudHelpSeen / WolfSledHudHelpSeen) and goes when the run starts
controls.when: HELP pressed, or the first ride
source: { 0, "HOW TO RIDE - THE ARROW KEYS ONLY" },
"E (or Page Up): jump.        C (or Page Down): crouch low to go faster."
"Left / Right arrow (or A / D): turn.        Down arrow (or S): slow down and stop."

controls.name: keys
controls.label: the HUD itself takes no keys: arrows (or W A S D), E / Page Up jump, C / Page Down crouch go to the ride's own script; sledges and discs the arrows only
source: "Up arrow (or W): push yourself along on the flat. It does not make you go faster downhill."
{ 1, "Left / Right arrow: lean to steer. A sledge turns in a wide curve; a snow disc only drifts." },
{ 1, "There is no jump key: bumps throw you in the air by themselves." },

controls.name: resize-grip
controls.label: top edge: drag to size (WolfSkiHudScale), double-click for the default, tooltip WolfHudResize::tip()

controls.name: click-through
controls.label: with the background on the whole band swallows clicks and right-clicks; off, only the controls do and clicks between the read-outs reach the world
source: return (mDrawn && mResize.onGrip(x, y)) || onPanel(x, y);   // no world context menu through the panel

controls.name: auto-show
controls.label: the HUD opens by itself on sitting on a Wolf ride when WolfSkiHudAuto is on, and takes the bottom (dashboard closes, deck hidden, helm gives way); a dashboard/deck/helm opened later takes it back; Wolf Territories only
controls.when: sitting on skis, snowboard, sledge or snow disc

controls.label: Skis
controls.tip: A pair of skis and poles. You stand on them.
source: tool_tip="A pair of skis and poles. You stand on them."

controls.label: Snowboard
controls.tip: A snowboard. You stand sideways on it.
source: tool_tip="A snowboard. You stand sideways on it."

controls.label: Sledge
controls.tip: A wooden sledge. You sit on it and lean to steer.
source: tool_tip="A wooden sledge. You sit on it and lean to steer."

controls.label: Snow disc
controls.tip: A round snow disc. You sit on it; it turns slowly round as it slides.
source: tool_tip="A round snow disc. You sit on it; it turns slowly round as it slides."

controls.label: How to ride: the chosen ride's keys (how_skis / how_board / how_sledge / how_disc)
Put my skis on / Put my snowboard on / Get on my sledge / Get on my snow disc

source: tool_tip="It appears at your feet and you are on it. Your free ones are in your inventory, under Objects."

controls.label: Get off (enabled only while riding)
controls.tip: Stand up. It goes back to your inventory, ready for next time.
source: tool_tip="Stand up. It goes back to your inventory, ready for next time."

controls.label: Show the Ski HUD (visible only while riding with the HUD hidden)
controls.tip: Bring back the HUD across the bottom of the screen.
source: label="Show the Ski HUD" layout="topleft" left="236" name="show_hud_btn"
tool_tip="Bring back the HUD across the bottom of the screen."

controls.label: Show the Ski HUD while I ride
controls.tip: Speed, steepness, your run time, jumps and style points across the bottom of the screen.
source: label="Show the Ski HUD while I ride"
tool_tip="Speed, steepness, your run time, jumps and style points across the bottom of the screen."

controls.label: Speeds in miles an hour
controls.action: setting WolfSkiHudMph (the same as the HUD's units chip)

controls.label: status line: already on / on / not riding / taken off / asking / given / the rez's progress / give errors (failures in a GenericAlertOK alert that stays)
source: <string name="not_riding">You are not on skis, a snowboard, a sledge or a snow disc just now.</string>
<string name="taken_off">Off. It is back in your inventory, ready for next time.</string>

controls.name: free-gift
controls.label: first open in a session asks wolfstorm.app/php/wolfskis.php to give the free skis, snowboard, sledge and snow disc that are missing; Put on waits for it

controls.label: opened off Wolf: an alert says why and the window closes
source: "Winter Fun is for Wolf Territories regions: the skis, sledges and snow discs need the Wolf grid's scripts."

controls.label: Wolf World > Winter Fun (Skis and Sledges)... (Floater.Show wolf_skis; Wolf Territories only)

controls.label: Wolf HUDs window tile Winter Fun (skis): toggles the Winter Fun window; lit while riding
